description: This is a shell script intended to manage the hotspot and hostapd processes, restarting WLAN interfaces and hostapd configurations based on certain trigger conditions and configuration parameters.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Restarts the hostapd service and reinitializes WLAN interfaces.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and reinitializes WLAN interfaces.
